title: 廢金屬渦電流分選
summary: 以「導電感應、粒子軌跡與非鐵回收」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow induction, particle trajectories and non-ferrous recovery through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 非鐵目標與前處理：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Non-ferrous targets and pretreatment: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 非鐵目標與前處理 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Non-ferrous targets and pretreatment and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 渦電流分選依導電性產生作用，並不等於傳統鐵磁吸附；先排除鐵件和尺寸極端物。
steps.instructionEn: Eddy-current action depends on conductivity, unlike ferromagnetic attraction; remove ferrous and extreme-size items first.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：target mass=feed*nonferrous fraction;500*0.12；計算 500*0.12 = 60 kg/h。適用限制：假想非鐵質量比例。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*nonferrous fraction;500*0.12; calculation 500*0.12 = 60 kg/h. Applicability: Hypothetical non-ferrous fraction.
steps.failure: 鐵件進入高速轉子區可能影響設備與分選。
steps.failureEn: Ferrous pieces entering the rotor zone can disrupt sorting and equipment.
steps.check: 把鐵、鋁和塑膠分別標示輸送路徑。
steps.checkEn: Trace steel, aluminium and plastic paths separately.

steps.title: 變動磁場與感應：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Changing field and induction: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 變動磁場與感應 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Changing field and induction and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 粒子經歷的磁通變化誘發電流，再與磁場作用改變軌跡；靜止均勻磁場不是同一機制。
steps.instructionEn: Changing magnetic flux induces currents that interact with the field and alter trajectories; a static uniform field differs.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：emf magnitude=N DeltaPhi/DeltaT;N=1;DeltaPhi=0.002Wb;dt=0.01s；計算 1*0.002/0.01 = 0.2 V。適用限制：簡化單迴路感應示例，非粒子完整模型。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: emf magnitude=N DeltaPhi/DeltaT;N=1;DeltaPhi=0.002Wb;dt=0.01s; calculation 1*0.002/0.01 = 0.2 V. Applicability: Simple loop example, not a full particle model.
steps.failure: 只看磁場強度而忽略變化率會漏掉感應來源。
steps.failureEn: Field strength alone misses the role of flux-change rate.
steps.check: 比較磁通變化時間加倍後的感應量級。
steps.checkEn: Double flux-change time and compare induced voltage.
